sections.changelog:
Changed

  • Admin UI migrated to MVweb Admin UI Kit v2 (slate palette, Yoast-style sidebar layout)
  • `admin.css` replaced with the current shared UI Kit framework
  • `plugin.css` rewritten to use `--brand`, `--slate-*`, `--shadow-*`, `--radius-*` variables
  • Settings page rebuilt with `.mvweb-sidebar` + `.mvweb-nav` + `.mvweb-main` layout
  • Tabs rendered as sidebar nav links; tab switching reworked accordingly
  • Forms list moved into `.mvweb-block` / `.mvweb-table-wrap`; empty state uses `.mvweb-empty`
  • Settings and Appearance forms migrated to `.mvweb-form-row` (label + field grid)
  • Form fields use `.mvweb-input` / `.mvweb-select` / `.mvweb-textarea` / `.mvweb-check`
  • Notices migrated from `.mvweb-notice` to `.mvweb-alert`
  • Help tab migrated to `.mvweb-block` / `.mvweb-steps` / `.mvweb-faq` / `.mvweb-codeblock`
  • Form editor dialog uses `.mvweb-dialog__head` / `.mvweb-dialog__foot`
  • Form editor data passed via `wp_localize_script` instead of an inline `
